name: theme-apple
title: Theme: Apple
description: Apple's system palette and HIG metrics as one more theme — capsule controls, continuous corners, systemBlue, and Liquid Glass on the glass, menu and raised finishes — installed into themes/apple/ (theme.json, finishes.json, index.ts) for `selectTheme` to switch to while the app runs.
